 Premier League Chelsea vs Manchester United live online: score, stats, goals & updates | Premier League 2026/27
 Live EPL commentary from Stamford Bridge, as Chelsea and Manchester United face off on matchday nine today, Saturday, October 31.
 AS USA Update: Oct 31st, 2026 08:00 EDT 0 Share facebook twitter whatsapp Make us preferred on Google Having been given the chance to turn around Manchester United’s poor run of form, Michael Carrick takes the Red Devils to West London for a crunch Premier League clash.
 After six league games without a win, United sit 16th in the English top flight , just one point above the drop zone . In their most recent Premier League outing, the 20-time domestic champions were humbled by Bournemouth, losing 3-0 at Old Trafford.
 Meanwhile, after a 2-0 matchday-eight defeat at home to Tottenham Hotspur, Chelsea are also seeking to return to winning ways . In their first season under Xabi Alonso, the Blues lie fifth, eight points off the top.
 Lineups are announced and players are warming up.
